description: Read one chat, oldest to newest: the latest messages, older ones with before (wazap asks the phone when the local history runs out), or a window with since/until. Long texts are cut unless full_text. chat_id "status": the stories of the last hours (a day at most), shown nowhere else.

chat_id.description: Chat id, number or name (one chat only); "status": stories

full_text.description: Each message's text whole; a list cuts long ones otherwise

hours.description: The last N hours; "status": 24 by default

include_previews.description: Attach a small image of each photo, up to 6

types.description: Only these types; limit counts them

name: read_messages

more_in_window.description: The window holds older messages than these: page on with before

notes.description: Caveats to act on or tell the user

older.description: before ran past the local history: the phone was asked, and sent this many

omitted.description: Older stories left out by limit

previews.description: The message_id of each attached image, in their order

resolved.description: chat_id was a name: the chat it resolved to

since.description: The window asked for, as read

unconfirmed_sends.description: Sends WhatsApp has not echoed yet: outcome unknown, not failed

title: Read messages from a WhatsApp chat
